subject: Security MAP: acceptance pillars + retention annex for Crestline
messages:
From: Elena Novak <enovak@crestlinebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff + compliance artifacts

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. To keep Procurement and Security aligned for the Crestline evaluation we need a clear Mutual Action Plan that lists the security/compliance gates, owners, and target dates. Specifically: SOC 2 readiness evidence, a completed SIG/CAIQ questionnaire, an executed DPA with our retention annex, and confirmation of EU/US data residency controls (we host some customer data in EU zones).

Can you send a draft MAP and proposed close timeline? Our target is to complete security review and sign DPA within 6 weeks so we can start an initial pilot in Q3.

Attachments: none

Elena Novak
Head of Security Operations
Crestline Bank
elena.novak@crestlinebank.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <enovak@crestlinebank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2028 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security MAP: acceptance pillars + retention annex for Crestline

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a preliminary SIG/CAIQ workbook. High level summary below, then the MAP milestones with owners and target dates (attachment: map_milestones_crestline_20280511.xlsx):

Key security gates (short):
- SOC 2 evidence intake: provide our SOC 2 Type II report + control mappings for the period Jan–Apr 2028 (Owner: Kimberly). Target: evidence posted to shared drive by 2028-05-18.
- SIG/CAIQ questionnaire: Redwood to complete initial pass; Crestline to mark any showstoppers and request clarifications (Owner: Marissa). Target: draft to you by 2028-05-13; final by 2028-05-20.
- DPA redlines & retention annex: legal teams to exchange a single redline round; we can accept a 12–18 month retention baseline with carveouts for regulated records. (Owner: Marcus). Target: sign by 2028-06-22 (6 weeks).
- Data residency & controls: we confirm US + EU region options; propose EU residency for EU customers and contractually enforceable routing (Owner: Kimberly). Target: confirmation by 2028-05-16.

Proposed close timeline (targeted, assumes quick procurement cycle):
1) 2028-05-11: MAP and SIG workbook (sent — attached)
2) 2028-05-13: Redwood SIG draft to Crestline
3) 2028-05-16: Data residency confirmation and control notes
4) 2028-05-18: SOC 2 evidence uploaded + evidence Q&A session (30m)
5) 2028-05-20: SIG finalization and signoff items list
6) 2028-06-01: Legal redline exchange DPA (single round)
7) 2028-06-08: Final negotiation and DocuSign send
8) 2028-06-22: Target signature and MAP closure

Attachments: map_milestones_crestline_20280511.xlsx, crestline_SIG_CAIXQ_v1.xlsx

If that timeline looks feasible to you we'll lock calendar invites for the evidence Q&A and the legal review checkpoint. Happy to shorten the DPA turnaround if Crestline can accept a pre-agreed retention baseline we already use for similar banking customers.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Novak <enovak@crestlinebank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security MAP: acceptance pillars + retention annex for Crestline

Quick clarification for the MAP:

- Retention annex baseline we propose is 12 months for non-sensitive logs, 24 months for support/incident telemetry, and 7 years for regulatory records where requested. Elena — does Crestline have any mandatory minimums above this for EU customers? If so we should capture them in the annex now to avoid redlines later.
- For SOC 2 evidence, I'll upload the report + control mapping to the shared folder by EOD Friday (2028-05-18).

Also recommending we add a short fallback bucket: if DPA negotiations take longer than 4 weeks past the target, Redwood will agree to a 30-day trial with an interim NDA and documented security posture for the pilot (limited seats). That often helps procurement move faster.

Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <enovak@crestlinebank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 May 2028 15:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security MAP: acceptance pillars + retention annex for Crestline

Elena —

Following up with an updated MAP and next steps after today's alignment call. Summary of changes: added retention tiers Kim suggested, added a legal checkpoint cadence, and included an interim pilot fallback.

Concrete next steps (owners):
- 2028-05-18 (TODAY): SOC 2 artifacts uploaded to shared drive (Kimberly) — done.
- 2028-05-20: SIG final review call (Marissa + Elena) — I'll send invite for 30m.
- 2028-06-01: DPA redline exchange (Marcus) — please send one consolidated redline to marcus_lin@redwood.com by COB 2028-05-31.
- 2028-06-08: Final DPA alignment — target to send DocuSign link 2028-06-08.
- 2028-06-22: Signature target and MAP close.

Attachments included: redlines_DPA_crestline_20280511.pdf (our suggested baseline redline), crestline_SIG_CAIXQ_v1.xlsx, map_milestones_crestline_20280511.xlsx

DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/CRS-4821/close-20280518

If Crestline can confirm the one consolidated redline approach, Marcus will prioritize legal review and we should be able to meet the 6-week commitment. If anything slips, we drop in the 30-day pilot fallback and proceed with limited scope.

Thanks everyone — locking invites now.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- crestline_SIG_CAIXQ_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
- map_milestones_crestline_20280511.xlsx (xlsx)
